name: 89403 · Dayton, NV
findings: ZIP 89403 (Dayton) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89403 (Dayton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89403 (Dayton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
